note: Structure-type and groin-vs-other-structure contrasts (e3,e4,e8,e9,e15,e30,e32) left out as variant-vs-variant. e22 convergence is judged on a PC1 score, so its effect is null. rra.1602 votes -1 (4 vs 1), f03-013 votes +1.

No mulch edge has a community functional-trait-composition outcome. e46 (mulch -> species assemblages) is species composition, not trait composition. e45 (mulch site vs other sites -> aspen SLA) is a site-vs-site contrast on one species' trait. Root mass, germination and height edges are growth outcomes.

Peat-extraction edges give bird densities, lichen/shrub richness or total tree cover (e32 block-cut vs unmined and vacuum, e60 post-vacuum less tree cover). Tree cover is abundance, not tree species composition or dominance, so they are left out under strict membership. Candidates may be incomplete.

COGROY study has conflicting edges for the same 1994 tableland plots (e8 increase, e35 decrease, e9 no effect), so its majority is 0. e48 is straw mulch plus fertilizer. Cover-soil placement edges are not mulching, and density/cover edges are not species counts.

Transplanting edges give richness (e29, e31) or cover (e2), not diversity or evenness. Richness is a separate class. e18 and e24 are turf/sod transplantation compared with the donor or undisturbed sites, not with untreated plots. Moss-transfer edges (e14, e25) are not planting.

Most planting edges contrast variants (seedling size, site, substrate, species, planting year) and are left out. e37 is growth over time with no unplanted control. e51 compares nursery stock with an unspecified control. e16 (planting -> emergent vegetation spread, no relationship) is a vegetation-extent outcome and is left out. e49 assumes revegetation of tailings means planting (pine plantations).

Acid deposition and emission edges concern lake water, not soil. Sewage sludge, PyC and N additions are amendments, not pollution. e26 (oiled plots -> PAH above background) left out because the outcome is the contaminant itself and the cause node is exposure duration. Candidates may be incomplete.

Woody-debris edges concern small-mammal survival, not seedlings or trees. e61 (strip-cut vs patch-cut -> planted survival) is a harvest-variant contrast. e25 (residual spruce -> seedling stocking) is a stocking outcome, not survival.
